title: TechRepublic Post Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for TechRepublic article/post objects returned by the WordPress REST API.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique numeric identifier for the post. Used as the path parameter for single-post retrieval.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Publication date in the site's timezone. ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: date_gmt
fields.description: Publication date in UTC/GMT. ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: modified
fields.description: Last modification date in the site's timezone.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-safe alphanumeric slug for the post. Used in the post's permalink.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Publication status. Public API only returns 'publish' status posts.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Full canonical URL to the post on TechRepublic.com.

fields.name: rendered
fields.description: HTML-rendered title text. May contain HTML entities.

fields.name: rendered
fields.description: Full HTML-rendered body content of the post.

fields.name: protected
fields.description: True if the post content is behind a password.

fields.name: author
fields.description: ID of the post's author. Use /users/{id} to fetch author details.

fields.name: featured_media
fields.description: ID of the featured image/media. 0 if no featured media.

fields.name: categories
fields.description: Array of category term IDs assigned to this post.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Array of tag term IDs assigned to this post.
